title: Rollout card walkthrough & annotated screenshot asset pack
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a reusable asset pack of interactive quickstart cards and annotated screenshot templates that demonstrate Rollouts and Version Pinning flows (canary, A/B, fallback policy). Deliverables should support marketing docs, in-product guided overlay, and docs screenshots with clear layering for annotations and accessibility variants.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with modular card components for canary, A/B, and fallback screens
Exported PNG/JPG templates for documentation (desktop, tablet, mobile) with 3 annotation layers: callouts, overlays, and keyboard flow
Animated GIFs (2s–6s) showing guided walkthrough sequences for canary and fallback scenarios
Accessibility variants: high-contrast color tokens and text-size scaled screenshots
Hand-off checklist completed with copy, microcopy, and dev QA notes and example console routes for instrumentation
assets_needed: Figma components: Card, TrafficSlider, VariantPill, FallbackBanner
Annotated source PDF for writer + localization
SVG callouts and numbered step overlays for translations
decision_log: 2026-02-18: Chose card-centric pattern over fullscreen modal to reduce cognitive load during initial onboarding (PM+Design consensus).
2026-02-23: Use progressive disclosure — card stepper reveals one policy control at a time to avoid misconfiguration.
2026-03-02: Fallback state will show a discrete red banner with a telemetry link rather than an intrusive modal to preserve request throughput visibility.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Ava: Kickoff sketches done; exploring stacked cards vs carousel. Attached early wireframes in Drive.
2026-02-20 - Jonah (PM): Prefer carousel on desktop, stacked on mobile. Need explicit callout for 'pin version' and 'set fallback'.
2026-02-25 - Marco (Eng): Confirmed variant pill states map to API field 'variant_id' and canary weight slider maps to traffic_percent in runtime API. Shared contract link.
2026-03-01 - Accessibility review (Priya): Colors fail 4.5:1 at default; suggest adjusted tokens and focus ring treatment. Added alt-text examples for all screenshots.
2026-03-05 - Design review: Iteration 2 reviewed. GIF timings adjusted to 800–1200ms per step; motion reduced for reduced-motion users. Diego to prepare final exports.
2026-03-09 - PM sign-off: Content approved for docs; requested an extra screenshot showing rollback flow. Added as new sub-task DES-99502.
next_steps: Finalize Figma components and export naming conventions (Diego)
Create GIFs with reduced-motion option and test on 3 viewport presets (mobile/ tablet/ desktop)
Produce annotated PDFs and hand off to Docs + Marketing
Coordinate with ENG to add telemetry markers (route names + event ids) for walkthrough completion
Close sub-tasks DES-99501 (export assets) and DES-99502 (rollback screenshot) before due date
